summary: Verified iteration_67 code-review remediation. All 6 findings (1 MEDIUM + 5 LOW) are correctly fixed. 9/9 backend pytest tests pass; frontend Playwright checks confirm FoundingMemberBadge undefined-code fallback + AdminCopilotPanel SSE cleanup + regression flows (login/dashboard/admin?tab=command).
critical_code_review_comments: MEDIUM FIX verified — /alerts-center uses insert-first dedupe (unique index on admin_alert_automation_fired.key + DuplicateKeyError catch). Under 5 parallel + 3 sequential concurrent polls, exactly 1 marker row exists and <=1 admin_automation_runs row for trigger='alert_high_severity'+key='reset-spike'. Marker is cleared by POST /alerts-center/{key}/resolve.
LOW FIX verified — /me/inspire rate-limited at 20/hr; 21st call returns 429 with detail 'Too many inspiration requests — please wait a few minutes'.

LOW FIX verified — /me/change-password rate-limited at 8/hr; 9th wrong-password call returns 429 with detail 'Too many password-change attempts — please wait an hour'. The counter increments on every attempt including 401 wrong-password paths (this is intentional per the reviewer's spec).
LOW FIX verified — /me/summary recent_events entries carry `kind` (not `event_type`). Confirmed by seeding a module_events row with kind='completed' and asserting the response payload.

LOW FIX verified — FoundingMemberBadge (Dashboard.jsx): when signup_discount_code is missing, badge renders the italic fallback 'Discount code pending — refresh in a moment.' and does NOT render the <code> element, the copy button, or the literal string 'undefined'. Verified via Playwright by patching a founding_member user to unset the code.

LOW FIX verified — AdminCopilotPanel SSE cleanup: useEffect(() => () => { abortRef.current?.abort(); }, []) is present at line 40. Opening the drawer, sending a message, and closing via ESC while streaming produced ZERO console warnings about 'unmounted component' or 'state update on unmounted'.

REGRESSION verified — (a) super-admin login → /dashboard load OK. (b) /admin?tab=command renders full KPI grid + Live Activity feed. (c) POST /api/auth/register still executes the user_signup automation dispatch (admin_automation_runs count did not decrease; hook is intact). (d) PATCH /api/me/daily-goal accepts 45 → 200, rejects 4 → 422, rejects 181 → 422. (e) Self-service portal (quote hero + FT avatar + stats + daily-goal card + personal details + Change password) renders on /dashboard. (f) GET /api/admin/automations returns rules list.

One observation (not blocking): The 429 detail messages are longer than the exact snippets the review request specified ('Too many inspiration requests' + 'Too many password-change attempts') — the required substrings are present, so no action needed.

seed_data_creation: Concurrency test seeds 15 rows in password_reset_tokens (seed_source='iter68_test') to trip the reset-spike alert threshold; a founding user was patched (founding_member_seq=42, signup_discount_code unset) for the FoundingMemberBadge Playwright test. All test data was purged in teardown.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All code-review remediations from iteration_67 are verified as fixed. Backend test file /app/backend/tests/test_iteration68_review_fixes.py can be re-used as a regression. Important note: the pytest suite must be run with `-o addopts=` to bypass the default xdist -n flag in /app/backend/pytest.ini — Motor async DB helpers do not survive xdist workers, so the file uses synchronous pymongo (MongoClient) throughout. If you need to seed password_reset_tokens, include a `token_hash` field (unique-indexed) to avoid E11000 dup-null errors.
rca of the issue: N/A — this iteration verified remediations; no new bugs uncovered. The MEDIUM alert-dedupe race is fully closed: unique index on admin_alert_automation_fired.key + DuplicateKeyError-guarded insert ensures at most one automation dispatch per (open-cycle × alert-key), and /resolve deletes the marker so re-fires after re-opening are still supported.
